fact: Car 87 collided with Car 10 in T13.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, team radio, in-car video evidence and submissions from the team and the team of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly) via the FIA Evidence Channel. Car 87 (Oliver Bearman) moved to overtake Car 10 at turn 11. The front axle of Car 87 was not ahead of the mirror of Car 10 at the apex where a collision occurred between the two cars. The Stewards determined that the driver of Car 87 was wholly to blame for the collision and imposed a 10 second penalty accordingly.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
evidence presented. ### Garry Connelly Matthew Selley ### Pedro Lamy Steve Pence
title: Infringement Car 87 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, TGR Haas F1 Team
